# Plan4Planet

> Plan4Planet is a community at the intersection of AI planning and climate decisions: automated planning and scheduling, multi-agent coordination, mechanism design, optimization, operations research and reasoning under uncertainty, applied to climate mitigation, adaptation, climate science and climate policy. Its first event is Planning for a Better Planet, an AAAI Fall Symposium 2026, held November 5 to 7, 2026 at the Westin Arlington in Arlington, Virginia, USA.

Key facts:

- Event: Planning for a Better Planet, AAAI Fall Symposium 2026, part of the AAAI Fall Symposium Series 2026.
- Dates: November 5 to 7, 2026. Venue: The Westin Arlington Gateway, 801 N Glebe Rd, Arlington, VA 22203, USA.
- Registration: https://aaai.getregistered.net/2026-fall-symposium/register (through AAAI, covers all three days).
- Organizing committee: Jim Boerkoel (Harvey Mudd College), Charles Dawson (Emerald AI), Jeremy Frank (NASA Ames Research Center), Alice Lépissier (Green Finance AI).
- Contact: info@plan4planet.org. Mailing list: https://groups.google.com/g/plan4planet-l/

## Pages

- [Home](https://plan4planet.org/): what the symposium is about, AI and climate research domains, goals, and how to attend.
- [Speakers](https://plan4planet.org/speakers/): invited speakers with affiliations and bios.
- [Accepted papers](https://plan4planet.org/papers/): accepted papers grouped by theme.
- [Schedule](https://plan4planet.org/schedule/): the program.
